subject: Lizardfish
topic: More than two kilometers down off Oregon, a pale fish with a huge, toothy mouth lies perfectly still on the seafloor.
script:
More than two kilometers down off Oregon, a pale fish with a huge, toothy mouth lies perfectly still on the seafloor.
This is a deep-sea lizardfish.
It's an ambush hunter. It waits, and waits, until something swims too close.
Then it strikes, and rows of needle-like teeth make sure nothing escapes.
Its wide mouth can take in prey that's surprisingly big for its size.
Near the Mariana Islands, another one surprised scientists by swimming high off the bottom.
In the empty deep sea, finding a partner can be really hard.
So scientists think each of these lizardfish may be both male and female at the same time.
That way, any other lizardfish it meets could be a mate.
Would you want to swim past that mouth?
pkg_title: This Deep-Sea Fish Is All MOUTH and Teeth 😬 #Shorts
